Game Overview

Flying Pig is a animal game built around guide a nimble pig through an exhilarating arcade adventure, snatching treats while dodging dangerous bombs. The challenge intensifies with progress, demanding swift reflexes and strategic maneuvering. Stay focused and agile in this family-friendly game that promises endless excitement and a test of skillful dexterity.
